$schema_note: Source of truth for agent work. Prose elsewhere is commentary; this file is authoritative. QA verifies THIS file, not chat history.

environment.$note: Pin every version a claim could depend on. QA verifies claims against THESE versions.

claims: <claim ids this step produced or depends on>

decisions.artifact: <file or path the decision produced, if any>

open_questions: <one unresolved question per entry, phrased so a yes/no or a number closes it>

claims.claim: <ONE atomic, checkable statement. Not 'X works with our setup' but 'X version N supports feature Y under condition Z.'>
claims.source: <URL of the official doc, or a description of the direct measurement>
claims.source_type: official_docs | release_notes | license_text | vendor_kb | code_inspection | direct_measurement | unverified_memory

claims.claim: EXAMPLE (delete): Flamenco 3.9.2 supports two-way path variables for cross-platform output paths.

qa.note: QA pass reads ONLY this file. For each claim: fetch the source, confirm it supports the statement for the pinned version, set verified/confidence, and log failures below. Run as a subagent with task.json as its only input.

resume_here: <ordered list: exactly what the next session should do first>
